steps.title: Draw a path
steps.body: Drag your finger across the sky to draw a path. The flock follows your line. Draw a path with at least 8 points.

steps.title: Feed the flock
steps.body: Guide the flock over the green field. The birds eat as they pass and the flock's energy grows. Let the flock gain 150 energy while the field lasts.

steps.title: Split the flock
steps.body: Use two fingers to split the flock into two sub-flocks, each following its own path. Split into 2 sub-flocks.

steps.title: Condense
steps.body: When the falcon strikes, pull the flock tight. Trigger a condense to draw the birds close together.

steps.title: Roost the flock
steps.body: At dusk, bring the flock to the roost. Settle 5 birds in the roost to finish the tutorial.
